meta.method: C000 is the place's own job count (block-level LODES WAC all jobs, summed to the place, else tract LODES weighted by place_pop_in_tract / tract_pop). CE01–03 apply the place's tract WAC wage mix to that count. CNS01–20 and the annualEmployment / annualWages trend are county totals apportioned by population share, then rescaled so their latest year equals C000. Commute FLOWS (within/inflow/outflow + residentWorkers/jobs) are instead aggregated from tract-level LODES (data/market/lodes_co.json), weighted by place_pop_in_tract / tract_pop — flows are NOT proportional to population, so county pop-weighting would erase a place's actual commute pattern (bedroom town vs job center). Per-place `flows_source` records which path produced the flows.
